visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male performer in a white t-shirt plays a red electric guitar on a stage illuminated by intense yellow and white spotlights. (2) Close-up shots of Taiwanese street food: fried meat dumplings in a deep-fryer basket followed by a small bowl of sticky rice topped with braised pork. (3) An overhead shot shows a dense festival crowd outdoors, many with their hands raised towards an outdoor stage during a sunny day. (4) A large wooden archway at the entrance of the 'Emerge Fest' is shown, decorated with colorful geometric shapes and festival logos. (5) A montage of festival activities including a female artist signing posters at a green table and a hand holding a themed cassette-design card. (6) A street dancer in a grey Adidas jacket performs in a park, followed by scenes of children climbing on a red rope structure. (7) An information poster lists local workshop schedules next to a shot of a dachshund sitting on a chair in a market area. (8) Traditional Chinese temple architecture of the 'Quinsui Stage' is shown with red lanterns and a modern concert stage set up in the square. (9) People are seen picnicking on mats on a grassy field; shots of local street vendors and old shop signs in the town. (10) Night scenes at the festival with blue and purple stage lights, a band performing, and attendees wearing green Attack on Titan capes. (11) Two people wave at the camera in front of the festival entrance sign as the video concludes.
